From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@odysseycap.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Encryption: ephemeral key usage & HSM sampling request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the SOC2/CAIQ support so far. Our auditor has a couple of specific asks around in-transit session key derivation and HSM sampling for a scoped period:

1) A short explainer (1 page) describing how session keys are derived for TLS-terminated services vs. application-layer ephemeral keys used by your inference runtime (KDF, nonce usage, HKDF pulls, etc.).
2) A small sample of rotation events and associated logs (redacted IDs ok) covering a two-week window in September 2026 showing key versioning, rotation timestamps, and operator approvals.
3) The most recent HSM attestation or vendor-signed seal (PDF) used for the tenant key wrapping KEK.

Can you confirm you can provide items #1-#3 and whether you need an NDA or secure link preference? Auditor timeline is tight — they asked for delivery by EOD Thursday, 2026-10-22 if possible.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Security Assurance Lead
Odyssey Capital

[Attachment: auditor-ask.pdf (pdf)]

- Wed 10/21: internal review & redaction; HSM attestation pulled from vendor portal.
- Thu 10/22 (EOD): deliver artifacts and short explainer doc.

Preferences: presigned S3 links are easiest for us and we will timebox access (7 days). If you require SFTP or a signed NDA first, please let us know.

Looping in Ben Carter (crypto ops) and Laura Bennett (compliance) to coordinate artifacts.

Best,
